title: tscv-vision: Structured representation engineering for time series

creators.name: Ribeiro, Diogo
creators.affiliation: School of Media Arts and Design, Polytechnic of Porto, Portugal

description: tscv-vision is a NumPy-first framework for constructing, combining, analyzing, and evaluating structured representations of time-series data. It includes image encoders such as Gramian Angular Fields, recurrence plots, wavelet and spectral transforms, graph and nonlinear-dynamics representations, classical descriptors, representation metadata, leakage-safe evaluation, and sliding-window processing plus a command-line workflow for NumPy .npy files.
notes: The core package is designed to keep runtime dependencies minimal, with NumPy as the primary dependency and heavier integrations exposed through optional extras. Release archives are intended to support reproducible citation of the source code corresponding to each tagged version.
